title: Vintage SF Bay Area Lot 1975 Bay Area Guide BART Postcards Fort Point Coliseum
condition_description: Booklet complete and intact; cable car and BART cards unposted and blank; Coliseum card posted with message and 8c stamp; 1975 guide with light wear and toning. Faint stain along one edge of the postcard booklet back (pictured).
description:
Vintage San Francisco Bay Area lot - postcards and a 1975 visitor guide:

1) Souvenir postcard booklet - "6 Detachable Post Cards, Fort Point National Historic Site, San Francisco, California", original 50 cent cover price. Photos by Pierre Atlan (P-24).

Views include:
- Cannon Rooms, Fort Point
- Aerial View - the Golden Gate
- 12 Pounder Napoleon Cannon
- Aerial View of Fort Point
- Sally Port Entrance, Fort Point

2) "Cable Car, San Francisco Hill & Alcatraz Island" - the cable car climbing the steep Hyde St. hill with Alcatraz and the Bay behind. Smith Novelty Co., San Francisco, P86257, Plastichrome by Colourpicture, color by John H. Atkinson, Jr. Deckle edges, unposted and blank.

3) "Lake Merritt Station, Oakland, Calif." - a BART train at the platform; one of 34 Bay Area Rapid Transit stations. Smith Novelty Co., San Francisco, 96798-C, made by Dexter Press, photo by Sandor Balatoni. Deckle edges, unposted and blank.

4) "Oakland - Alameda County Coliseum" - aerial view of the stadium and arena, home of the Oakland Raiders, Oakland Athletics and Oakland Oaks. Smith Novelty Co. 38925-C, made by Dexter Press, photo by Jerry French. Posted early 1970s from Oakland with an 8c flag stamp, "Always Use Zip Code" cancel, and a handwritten message mentioning a ride on the BART train.

5) Official Bay Area Guide, week beginning July 24, 1975 - "The New Edition of the Official Amusement Guide", published every Thursday since 1920. Special BART Section (pages 9-24); movies, theatre, dining, shopping, sightseeing and special events. Cover: Jim Dale in the Young Vic production of "Scapino" at the Geary Theater. Back cover: Dana Hills homes ad (Clayton, CA - "find a seat on BART"). Light wear and toning.

Condition: booklet complete and intact - no cards detached, none written on or posted. Light toning and a faint stain along one edge of the back (see photos).

Ships flat with a stiffener in a protective mailer.
